verses.kjv_text: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
verses.accepted_text: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may grasp that for which also I am grasped by Christ Jesus.

changes.reason: R3: "apprehend" is no longer understood in its KJV sense of laying hold of, and "grasp" is the closest one-word equivalent.
R3: same word as "apprehend", kept consistent in the passive (P7).
R5: the agent "of" is archaic and cannot stand with the modern passive, so "by" is required by the change.

verses.kjv_text: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
verses.accepted_text: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

verses.kjv_text: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
verses.accepted_text: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

verses.kjv_text: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
verses.accepted_text: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

verses.kjv_text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
verses.accepted_text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which has begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

verses.kjv_text: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
verses.accepted_text: Even as it is fitting for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, you all are partakers of my grace.

changes.reason: 'Meet' in this adjectival sense means 'suitable/fitting', which a modern reader would not understand; 'fitting' carries the same sense (R4).

verses.kjv_text: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
verses.accepted_text: For God is my witness, how greatly I long after you all in the affection of Jesus Christ.

changes.reason: R4: KJV "record" here means testimony borne by a witness, which a modern reader would take for a written account, so it must change.
R4 and glossary g-bowels-affection: the KJV sense is the seat of tender feeling, not entrails.

verses.kjv_text: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
verses.accepted_text: That you may approve things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

verses.kjv_text: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
verses.accepted_text: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

changes.reason: R3 and glossary g-unto-to: "unto" in this directional sense updates to "to".

verses.kjv_text: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
verses.accepted_text: But I would you should understand, brothers, that the things which happened to me have fallen out rather to the furtherance of the gospel;

changes.reason: R3: glossary entry g-brethren-brothers gives 'brothers' for fellow believers.
R3: glossary entry g-unto-to gives 'to' for direction or indirect object.
R3: glossary entry g-unto-to gives 'to' for direction or indirect object.

verses.kjv_text: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
verses.accepted_text: And many of the brothers in the Lord, growing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

changes.reason: R3: glossary entry g-brethren-brothers gives 'brothers' for fellow believers.
R3: 'waxing' in the sense of increasing is no longer in common use; 'growing' is the same meaning, one word for one word.

verses.kjv_text: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
verses.accepted_text: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

result.reason: The verses use "of" in different senses: PHP.3.12 marks the agent after a passive verb (g-of-by, "by"), while the other verses mark belonging (e.g. "servants of Jesus Christ", "partakers of my grace") or source after receiving ("received of Epaphroditus", g-of-keep, KEEP). The divergence is therefore correct, and the existing glossary entries already split the senses.
